_comment: Golden bodies for agent click-to-dial and blind voice transfer (outbound-calls-reach-the-trunk, design D4). Routes: dial = POST /api/v1/voice/dial; transfer = POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/voice-transfer. `error` carries ONLY a kebab-case machine code. ApiJsonContext uses WhenWritingNull: accepted/correlationId/error keep it (a null one is OMITTED, as today), while trunkId opts out with JsonIgnoreCondition.Never. trunkId (JSON integer|null) is ALWAYS written: the resolved trunk's numeric id on trunk-not-dialable (409, refused before any leg rings and before any AMI action), null on every other answer. Every other status/code of the two routes is unchanged by this change. Every child change's delta spec must cite these codes and field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
